scripts.dev: cross-env PRISMA_DB_PROVIDER=sqlite SQLITE_DATABASE_URL=file:./prisma/dev.db prisma generate --schema prisma/schema.sqlite.prisma && cross-env PRISMA_DB_PROVIDER=sqlite SQLITE_DATABASE_URL=file:./prisma/dev.db next dev
scripts.build: cross-env PRISMA_DB_PROVIDER=postgres prisma generate --schema prisma/schema.prisma && cross-env PRISMA_DB_PROVIDER=postgres next build --webpack
scripts.db:push:supabase: cross-env PRISMA_DB_PROVIDER=postgres prisma db push --schema prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.db:push:sqlite: cross-env PRISMA_DB_PROVIDER=sqlite SQLITE_DATABASE_URL=file:./prisma/dev.db prisma db push --schema prisma/schema.sqlite.prisma
scripts.db:migrate:supabase: cross-env PRISMA_DB_PROVIDER=postgres prisma migrate deploy --schema prisma/schema.prisma
